description: Soft bokeh particle field on canvas: dozens of luminous, depth-sized orbs drift upward, swaying on a slow noise field, drawn additively so they glow where they overlap; the pointer nudges them aside. Optional eyebrow/title/body copy centred over the field behind a readability veil. Honours prefers-reduced-motion (one static frame), pauses offscreen, DPR-aware. Was a "canvas fallback placeholder" until 2026-09-19 (a grey box on GAS and MCP Apps); now a real atom on the same kit as flow_field, identical on every renderer. Every option is an enum or a clamped int; colours must be #rrggbb.
